summary.text: Ashley Thornton is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 56 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Pat Curry.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said public schools are the issue closest to her heart and the main reason she is running.

paragraphs.text: Thornton listed her policy interests in the survey as public education, health care, childcare, public transportation, fair taxes, fair representation and protecting freedom wisely and responsibly.

sources.title: Ashley Thornton - Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey
